definitions.short: Beth-Shean or Beth-Shan , a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H1052. Beth Shean שְׁאָן בֵּית proper name, of a location in Manasseh, west of Jordan ( place of quiet ) 1Kin 4:12 (twice in verse); בֵּיתשְֿׁאָן Josh 17:11 , 16 ; Judg 1:27 ; 1Chr 7:29 ; = שָׁ֑ן בֵּית 1Sam 31:10 , 12 ; בֵּיתשַֿׁן 2Sam 21:12 ; — modern Beisân (Scythopolis), Late Hebrew בֵּישָׁן Rob BR iii. 329 Bd Pal 224 Survey i. 101 f .
definitions.rootNote: or בֵּית שָׁן ; from 1004 and 7599 ; house of ease;
